title: Export Manifest (v1.1)
description: Self-describing manifest written (last, atomically) at the root of every export bundle, {output}/{system}/{run_id}/. The ONLY coupling between the exporter and the Migration Cockpit. 1.1 adds multiple source systems and resources that were skipped or failed (recorded without a file). JSONL resources, full snapshots, no documents.

format_version.description: Semver MAJOR.MINOR of the bundle contract. The Cockpit pins a supported MAJOR range; MAJOR bump = breaking layout change.

status.description: complete: every resource complete. partial: at least one complete, others skipped or failed. A run where nothing completes writes no bundle.

date_range.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD days. Applies only to the source's dated resources (ledgers); everything else is exported in full.

categories.description: Which of the source's categories this run requested (see `ramp-exporter sources`).

resources.description: One entry per resource the run attempted. Key = the source's resource name (e.g. users, transactions, cash_statements).

file.description: Path relative to bundle root, e.g. users.jsonl. Absent when skipped or failed.

sha256.description: Checksum of the file; the Cockpit verifies on ingest.

reason.description: Plain-language reason a resource was skipped or failed.

scope.description: The token permission that would have allowed a skipped resource.

counts_summary.description: Flat resource -> row_count map for quick display.
